note: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire's conditions for the second half of 2026 (read 2026-11-03; until then those for the first half, May 2026, which gave the same figures): keeping an account costs 5,500 francs a month, taxes included, for a non-salaried private customer, the rate for a customer who isn't salaried, as a performer working by engagement is (3,850 for the salaried).

sources.title: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire, Conditions applicables au titre du second semestre 2026, linked from https://cotedivoire.coris.bank/
sources.said: CORIS BANK INTERNATIONAL CÔTE D’IVOIRE ... AU TITRE DU SECOND SEMESTRE 2026 ... 2.1.1.7 Frais de tenue de compte (tarif mensuel) ... Salariés 3 850 FCFA TTC/mois ... Particuliers non salarié 5 500 FCFA TTC/mois
